tools.name: findTemplates
tools.description: [No connection needed] Search public delivery templates (scope, completion criteria, required evidence) by scenario, for example "n8n workflow" or "chatbot". Read-only; creates nothing.

tools.name: getTemplate
tools.description: [No connection needed] Read one exact public template version returned by findTemplates. Use its criteria as a starting point for prepareAgreement after the user reviews them.

tools.name: getResultStatus
tools.description: [No connection needed] Read signed public status using an existing disclosed status-link resultId (result_ + 64 hex), not a Conformity Record URN. Discloses status only, never content. 404 means unknown, withdrawn from disclosure or retired. Verify offline with independently confirmed issuer keys; s

tools.name: getTrustBundle
tools.description: [No connection needed] Read the public issuer keys needed to verify an exported result offline with /developers/verify-conformity.mjs. Confirm the keys through an independent channel before relying on them.
